# Accepted six-piece plan

`inf64.json` retains the original INF-64 report, card and decision 64825, extracted by the read-only INF-86 investigation.
Report SHA-256: `7fa1bf743fd99f4e068a4972402647243b1f3bf3d505c0c1eecb1f479783ce8c`.
Card body SHA-256: `12c9d188585c2ef8df66bd9cef220e0043032782bff0f65c9e9117e588b2d770`.
The submitted `phonecode=piece2` overrides the recommendation of piece 6.
The host regression uses these contents unchanged, on disposable task and card identities.
The account evaluation substitutes only `INF-13` with `P` and `INF-16` with `BUILD` in the saved contents and user words, and maps those aliases to fresh records.
No evaluation reaches the historical tasks or starts real iOS work.
The initial evaluation input contains the production-rendered answer-close receipt and a compact task index, not the plan contents or answers.
The full contents are available through the first mate's native `tasks` tool.

## Larger design record

`inf91.json` retains the complete keyed `tasks` response for INF-91 (`182c1d82`), captured from INF-87's own tool transcript without opening the app database.
Its selected action is `continue-design`, with `look=story` and `storage=native`; it is not build approval.
The transport regression expands the rendered response back to the entire captured row.
The second live evaluation seeds its report, brief, goal, card and submitted answers through the production services on disposable identities.
A pre-existing read-only continuation and a held implementation test successor reuse and the design boundary.
The case must actually use length-framed text, not merely have a large fixture name.
Neither evaluation touches the historical task or grants publication or merge permission.

## Early automatic starts

`inf143-early-starts.json` retains the four actual `create_task` calls from INF-143's live run on b1bf8a5.
Each requested `when-ready` without declaring blockers; the next model response linked them, after all four had already started.
The regression replays these calls through the isolated production host and requires refusal before any row or session exists.
A declared blocker list and on-request drafting remain supported; no test guesses dependencies from the recorded goals.
